podcast.title: Independent Label Leadership
podcast.body: Portia Sabin serves as the president of Kill Rock Stars, which is described as a "very cool indie label," highlighting its respected position in the independent music scene. "Portia Sabin is the president of the very cool indie label Kill Rockstars."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Driven By Her: Women of the 21st Century

podcast.title: Olympia-based Indie Label
podcast.body: Kill Rock Stars is an indie label from Olympia, identified as one of the more important labels in the American Pacific Northwest that released records by bands like Mecca Normal. It played a significant role in distributing music from the nascent Riot Grrrl and indie scenes. "Kilroch stars also from Olympia"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
